newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power softer amid milder temps.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power softer amid milder temps.

text.p: Day-ahead electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. were generally lower Thursday amid outlook of milder temperatures in the region Friday.
Friday's weather was forecast to moderate slightly from the today's frigid levels, with day readings in the 20-30 degree Fahrenheit range and night reading in the teens to 20s.
The northeastern corner of the country was expected to be hit by snow and sleet Thursday and see clear skies Friday through the weekend.

Peak, non-firm electricity prices (including transmission costs) for Friday delivery in the eastern part of the New York Power Pool (NYPP) tightened to $30.50-$31.50 a megawatt hour (MWh) from Wednesday's range of $29.00-$31.50.
Off-peak, non-firm power for next-day delivery in eastern NYPP was quoted near $22.00 against $21.00-$22.00 Wednesday.

In western NYPP, peak, non-firm power for Friday fell to $23.00-$24.00/MWh from a range of $24.00-$25.00 Wednesday on lower prices in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool, where day-ahead prices fell two to three dollars from Wednesday.
Western NYPP electricity for off-peak, non-firm delivery Friday was valued at $14.50-$15.50, lower than $15.00-$16.00 Wednesday for Thursday delivery.
"People can't get it to PJM. It'll only make it cheaper here," said a New York electricity trader.

In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), peak, non-firm electricity for day-ahead delivery at Northeast Utilities' (NU) border was quoted near $33.00/MWh, softer than a range of $34.00-$35.00 Wednesday.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for next-day delivery to the NU border was valued at $21.50-$23.00, steady from Wednesday's level.
Cash natgas prices were also pressured lower by the milder weather outlook.
Swing gas prices at the New York City gate fell to $4.00 per million British thermal unit level from Wednesday's $4.30.
On the New York Mercantile Exchange, February Henry Hub gas futures slipped 9.3 cents to $3.420, trimming an early 26.3 cent loss.
